name: Case Preparation
scope: Bulk user-mode Case evidence packets with mandatory contact/description checks and source modification stamps.

requirements.acceptance: Completeness means satisfying explicit requirements, not having a long summary.
requirements.coverage: Native Case checklist covers Subject, Description and ContactId.
requirements.blocker: Checklist not approved by actual process owner; no authority/freshness policy beyond current field source stamp.

requirements.acceptance: Each material fact cites its source and extraction uncertainty.
requirements.coverage: User-mode Case extraction returns record URL and LastModifiedDate with scoped missing fields.
requirements.blocker: Document/OCR extraction and uncertainty calibration not implemented.

requirements.acceptance: Conflicts are surfaced without fabricated resolution.
requirements.coverage: Unavailable Case remains UNKNOWN; scoped missing values remain explicit.
requirements.blocker: Conflicting source identities/dates, supersession and reconciliation not implemented.

requirements.acceptance: Consumers can distinguish established facts from proposals and unknowns.
requirements.coverage: Flow invocable returns source reference, stamp, missing fields and scoped completeness state.
requirements.blocker: Production Flow/Agentforce registration and permitted next-step authority pending.

requirements.acceptance: Reported benefit includes material omissions and downstream rework.
requirements.coverage: Native tests specify source stamp, unknown Case and incomplete evidence controls.
requirements.blocker: Reviewer correction UI, independent omission labels and measured effort comparison absent.

blockers: Scoped metadata compilation and unit tests passed; broader integration, denied-user scenarios, actual domain policies and independent evaluation remain incomplete.
Original acceptance requirements remain partial; owner validation, comparative benchmarks and independent evidence pending.
commands: sf project deploy start --dry-run --target-org eb1a-dev --manifest manifest/package.xml --test-level RunSpecifiedTests --tests CasePreparationActionTest

native_validation.scope: one Developer org; scoped unit tests and supplied metadata only
